title: KidVis: Do Multimodal Large Language Models Possess the Visual Perceptual Capabilities of a 6-Year-Old?
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating visual perceptual capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) against a human physiological baseline, categorizing capabilities into six dimensions (Discrimination, Memory, Concentration, Tracking, Spatial, and Closure). There is no component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. While 'Moravec's Paradox' is mentioned, it is a philosophical observation regarding AI capabilities, not an ethical or faith-based evaluation component.
